passive.name: Mado Legacy
passive.description: Akira gains a stack with every basic attack that hits an enemy champion, and a fraction of one for each minion or monster she kills. On reaching the threshold, she trades her Amatsu quinque for the two Fueguchi quinques: a longer, deadlier whip and four shield-like wings. Her basic attacks gain range and damage, she gains a small amount of armor penetration, and her abilities are empowered.

stacks.championHit: 1 per basic attack that hits an enemy champion

h1.name: Quinque Lash
h1.description: Akira lashes her whip several times in a cone in front of her, dealing damage with each hit and healing herself slightly. Fueguchi: greater range, damage and healing.

heal.value: 10% of the damage dealt to champions

fueguchi.heal: 18% of the damage dealt to champions

h2.name: Piercing Thrust
h2.description: Akira retracts her whip into its koukaku form, a long blade, which takes a brief moment, then lunges forward with a powerful thrust. Fueguchi: becomes a parry; she raises her four wings as a shield, barely able to move, then strikes in a direction with a short thrust that does not dash.

h3.name: Suppression Grenade
h3.description: Akira throws a CCG gas grenade that silences enemies caught in the area for 1 second. Holds up to 2 charges.

h4.name: Verdict of the Whip
h4.description: Akira spins her whip around her, repeatedly damaging nearby enemies and healing herself slightly, then pulls them in with a final lash. Fueguchi: greater range and damage.

finalLash.pull: Enemies are pulled 300 units toward Akira

heal.value: 15% of the damage dealt to champions

lore:
Akira Mado is a Ghoul Investigator of the CCG and the daughter of the legendary Kureo Mado. She graduated at the top of her class at the Academy, driven by the conviction that ghouls were nothing but monsters, a belief hardened into cold hatred when her father was killed by one. Partnered with Koutarou Amon and later assigned to mentor Haise Sasaki and the Quinx Squad, she grew to care for them far more than she would ever admit. As the truth behind the CCG and the ghouls she hunted came to light, her certainty crumbled, and she chose to stand with the United Front, fighting for a future her father never imagined.

Akira is a methodical, analytical fighter who studies her enemies before striking. She wields Amatsu, a whip-like quinque that can retract into a blade, and later inherits the Fueguchi quinques her father forged from the ghouls he hunted: a long, spine-like lash and a set of wing-like shields. Stern, perfectionist and dryly sarcastic, she hides her loyalty behind discipline and rarely lets anyone see how deeply she cares.
